name: CSS Scan
summary: Paid point-and-copy inspector that shows the active CSS of any hovered element with declarations cleaned up, including pseudo-classes and media queries, with optional Tailwind output.
publisher: getcssscan.com (Guilherme Vieira Rizzo listed as developer)
price: Paid (store text: "This extension is paid and requires a license to use it")
browsersNote: Vendor site claims Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge builds, but no Firefox or Edge store listing was found on the check date.
goodFor: Copying clean, computed CSS for any element, including pseudo-classes.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: css scanner design tokens style extractor tailwind computed declarations
